$meta.name: Noodlegear Design Tokens
$meta.basedOn: Microsoft Fluent 2 — @fluentui/react-components v9 (webLightTheme / webDarkTheme generated from the brand ramp below)
$meta.sourceOfTruth: This file is the single source of truth for every visual value in Noodlegear. Docs: docs/design-tokens.md.
howToConsume: Colour, typography, spacing, radius, stroke, shadow and motion: use the Fluent token named in `fluentToken` (e.g. tokens.colorNeutralBackground2). Never paste the hex/px value into code.
Build the Fluent themes with createLightTheme(brand) / createDarkTheme(brand) using `brand`, then apply the overrides listed in `themeOverrides`.

Noodlegear-only groups (layout, breakpoints, zIndex, iconSize, density, status) have no Fluent equivalent. Expose them as CSS variables named `--ng-<group>-<kebab-key>` (e.g. --ng-layout-header-height) generated from this file.
Values under `light` / `dark` are for reference, design review and non-React tooling. They are produced by Fluent and must not be redefined by hand.

brand.$description: Fluent 2 BrandVariants ramp (10 = darkest, 160 = lightest). Microsoft enterprise web blue. 80 is the primary accent in light theme.

themeOverrides.$description: Applied on top of the generated Fluent themes. Nothing else may be overridden.

color.$description: Semantic colour roles. Use the role that describes the job, never a colour that merely looks right.

surface.usage: Header, sidebar, sections, tables, panels, dialogs, inputs.

surfaceHover.usage: Hovered table row / list item on a surface.

surfaceSelected.usage: Selected row / active record in a list.

subtle.usage: Inset areas: table header band, read-only field groups, code.

brandTint.usage: Selected nav item background tint, informational highlight. Never a large fill.

secondary.usage: Field labels, secondary values, icons in toolbars.

tertiary.usage: Descriptions, metadata, timestamps, helper text, column headers.

quaternary.usage: Placeholder-level emphasis only. Not for essential information.

disabled.usage: Disabled controls only (exempt from contrast rules).

brand.usage: Selected nav text/icon, active tab, brand emphasis.

rest.usage: Primary button, checked checkbox/switch/radio, progress fill.

divider.usage: Section/surface borders, header and sidebar separators, table row lines.

subtle.usage: Dividers inside a surface (between description-list rows).

accessible.usage: Input bottom border, checkbox/radio outlines (3:1 non-text contrast).

brand.usage: Focused input underline, selected indicator bar.

inner.usage: Inner ring of the focus indicator.

outer.usage: Outer 2px ring of the focus indicator.

status.$description: Only for communicating state. Always paired with a text label or icon; colour alone never carries meaning.

base.value: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

monospace.usage: IDs, licence numbers, registration plates when alignment matters.

numeric.usage: Apply to money, counts, times and dates in tables and metrics.

scale.$description: Use Fluent `typographyStyles.<name>` or the <Text>/<Caption1>/<Body1>/<Subtitle2>/<Title3> components. Nothing above title2 is allowed in the application.

caption1.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text, badge text, table footers.

body1.usage: Default UI text: cells, inputs, labels, paragraphs.

body1Strong.usage: Emphasis inside body text, primary cell (record name).

subtitle2.usage: Section headings, dialog titles of small dialogs, panel section titles.

subtitle1.usage: Dialog titles, detail panel titles, empty-state titles.

spacing.$description: 4px grid. Fluent defines horizontal and vertical variants with identical values (spacingHorizontalM / spacingVerticalM). Use the axis that matches the property.

xs.usage: Label to control, inline icon gap, between stacked caption lines.

s.usage: Between buttons in a group, toolbar item gap, cell inner gap.

m.usage: Filter bar gap, card internal gap, description-list row gap.

l.usage: Section padding, form field vertical gap, gap between sections, compact page gutter.

xxl.usage: Page side gutter (desktop), form column gap, between page header and content.

xxxl.usage: Empty-state padding. Largest spacing in the app.

none.usage: Header, sidebar, table cells, full-bleed regions.

small.usage: Checkbox, small tags, status dots inner.

medium.usage: DEFAULT. Buttons, inputs, sections, cards, menus, badges.

style.usage: Always solid. Dashed only for file drop zones.

shadow.$description: Elevation communicates layering, not decoration. Static page content has NO shadow — use a 1px divider border instead.

level0.usage: Page content, sections, tables, metric cards, header, sidebar.

shadow2.usage: Sticky table header / sticky form footer when content scrolls under it.

shadow4.usage: Hover lift on interactive cards (optional, sparingly).

shadow16.usage: Menus, popovers, dropdown lists, date picker (Fluent).

motion.$description: Use Fluent component motion only. No custom or decorative animation. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

contentMaxWidth.usage: Max width of page content on very wide screens (list/dashboard pages).

detailPanelWidthWide.usage: Side panel containing a form or table.

dialogWidthLarge.usage: Rare. Multi-column forms. Prefer a page or panel.

formColumnMinWidth.usage: Minimum width of a form grid column before it wraps.

breakpoints.$description: Min-width breakpoints in px. Desktop-first: design at lg (1366), adapt down. CSS variables cannot be used in media queries — use the raw numbers via a TS constant.

sm.usage: Below: phone. Single column, stacked filters, card-list instead of wide tables.

md.usage: Below: tablet. Sidebar becomes an overlay drawer, form grids collapse to 1 column, compact gutter.

xl.usage: Wide desktop. Content stops at contentMaxWidth.

zIndex.$description: In-page layers only. Fluent overlays (Dialog, Drawer, Popover, Menu, Tooltip, Toast) render in portals and manage stacking themselves — never assign them a z-index.

raised.usage: Focused/selected element overlapping a neighbour's border.

sticky.usage: Sticky table header, sticky form footer, sticky command bar.

sidebar.usage: Inline sidebar when it overlaps content.

overlay.usage: Reserved. Custom overlays are not allowed; listed to prevent ad-hoc values.

iconSize.$description: Fluent UI React Icons (@fluentui/react-icons). Use the size-suffixed export (e.g. Calendar20Regular) or the un-suffixed one inside Fluent slots (Fluent sizes it).

small.usage: Inside table cells, badges, captions, inline with 12px text.

medium.usage: DEFAULT. Buttons, nav items, toolbars, inputs, menus.

large.usage: Page-level emphasis, metric card icon, message bar.

style.value: Regular at rest; Filled for selected/active state (use bundleIcon(Filled, Regular) in nav).

density.$description: Control and row sizes. Noodlegear is compact-but-comfortable.

controlHeightSmall.usage: Controls inside table rows and dense toolbars.

controlHeightMedium.usage: DEFAULT for all buttons, inputs, selects, date pickers.

tableRowSmall.usage: DEFAULT for list screens (learners, bookings, payments).

tableRowMedium.usage: Tables whose rows contain avatars or two-line cells.

status.$description: The ONLY allowed mapping from business statuses to visual tone. Add new statuses here first, then use them. tone → Fluent Badge: success→success, warning→warning, danger→danger, info→brand, neutral→informative; appearance 'tint' in tables, 'filled' never.

warning.meaning: Needs attention soon: due, partially paid, expiring.

danger.meaning: Problem or blocked: overdue, failed, no-show, off road.
